title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured in text using Winogender and Winobias datasets to evaluate coreference resolution bias, and in image-to-text tasks by comparing captioning quality (CIDEr scores) and testing for ungrounded inferences across different gender appearances using the MIAP dataset.
Measured in image-to-text capabilities by comparing captioning quality (CIDEr scores) and testing for ungrounded inferences across different skin tones using the MIAP dataset.

Evaluated via a zero-shot classification style evaluation using the Dollarstreet dataset to measure performance discrepancies across images from different geographic locations and lower socioeconomic regions.

Evaluated in text capabilities using the Bias Benchmark in QA (BBQ) dataset to calculate a bias score based on whether models challenge or reinforce stereotypes, and in video-to-text by prompting models and checking outputs for ungrounded inferences that reinforce stereotypes.
